summary: RETEST of iteration_127 fixes for the B2B pre-payment gate. Backend: 15/15 regression tests in test_b2b_prepayment_gate.py and 13/13 new tests in test_b2b_prepay_fixes_iter128.py pass. Verified: confirm with amount -5 or 0 returns 422 'greater than 0'; an underpayment returns 400 naming both amounts and the intent goes back to awaiting_payment; exact payment and overpayment both succeed; a repeat confirm returns already_confirmed with the same order_id; 4 concurrent confirms gave 1x200 and 3x400 'already being confirmed', with exactly 1 order per client_ref; a confirm succeeds while the shop is manually locked; include_all=true lists shops with no dues; a proof against another shop's order returns 400 with the exact message; a general proof settles orders oldest first (partial proof: still_blocked=dues; full proof: can_order_now=true, gate can_order=true, outstanding 0); an identical intent returns the same id; mobile v2 payment-gate, checkout-intent (400 at 50%, awaiting_gateway at 70%, deduped) and payment-proofs (including the foreign-order 400) work. Frontend (http://localhost:3000, Next.js prod; the public preview URL is still unreachable): the ladder updates in place at 70/80/90/100 (re-pricing takes about 2.3s, with Calculating on the calculate button); 100% drops the grand total from Rs1,055 to Rs1,039 (1.5% cash discount); the amount is a read-only span; the balance and CTA update. place-order-btn and the ladder are disabled when the shop is locked. The legacy cash-discount toggle is hidden while the gate is on and comes back when it is off. With the gate off the classic order is placed (DB shows a pending order) and the ladder is gone. The awaiting state shows 'Awaiting payment · INT-xxx' plus the desk note. Register ?gstin= prefill works (an invalid GSTIN is ignored). The admin page title and Outstanding text are legible in dark mode. NEW issues: (1) the intent dedupe key ignores shipping, voucher, credit note and rewards, so a stale, wrongly priced intent comes back; (2) the awaiting CTA label goes stale after a percent change; (3) the Order Summary item names and values are invisible (inherited colour rgb(250,250,250) on a white card); (4) the admin page title is invisible in admin Light Mode; (5) the admin UI never passes include_all=true.

critical.issue: create_intent() cart_signature only covers (product_id, quantity_boxes), not include_shipping, delivery_pincode, voucher_code, credit_note_code or redeem_rewards_inr. Reproduced: an intent with include_shipping=false (Rs5,275.99), then the same items with include_shipping=true and pincode 560001, returned the SAME intent INT-1555EBF1EF60 at Rs5,275.99, while /calculate gives Rs5,488.71 (Rs212.72 shipping). Confirming it creates an order without shipping, or with a wrong voucher or credit note. The dedupe key also ignores provider and channel.

minor.issue: If the process dies between the claim and place_order, the intent stays in 'confirming' forever and every later confirm returns 400 'already being confirmed'. There is no recovery path (no stale-claim timeout using claimed_at).

When a webhook retry races a confirm that succeeds, the loser gets ValueError('already being confirmed') and sets confirm_failed=True on an intent that was actually confirmed. This is a misleading flag.

The pending->verified step is find-then-update, not atomic. Two concurrent approvals of the same proof could credit the money twice (the same pattern as the old confirm_intent race). Use find_one_and_update({status:'pending'}).
The find_one-then-insert dedupe is not atomic, so two simultaneous taps can still create two intents. Low impact.
N+1: dues_summary() is called per active retailer, and each call runs get_settings(). This will be slow with many shops.

ui_bugs.issue: Item name, line total, Subtotal value and GST value have no explicit text colour, so they inherit body colour rgb(250,250,250) (html.dark) on the white summary card and are practically invisible. Add text-gray-900 (or similar) to the card container or the spans.

After an intent is saved at 70% (CTA 'Awaiting payment · INT-4C7703F6071A'), switching to 90% re-prices the amount to Rs1,899 but the CTA still shows the old 70% intent id. The CTA also stays enabled, so another click opens a second intent at 90% and the 70% one stays on the admin desk. Clear awaitingIntent when payPercent, voucher or credit note changes (the code only clears it on quantity change), or disable the CTA while awaiting.
The h1 is hard-coded 'text-white'. In admin Light Mode (toggle-dark-mode) the title is white on a near-white background and invisible. Use 'text-slate-800 dark:text-white' like the other admin pages.

integration_issues.flow: Admin lock a shop that owes nothing
integration_issues.issue: The backend supports ?include_all=true, but app/admin/b2b-payments/page.js always fetches /api/admin/b2b-payments/retailers without it. An admin still cannot lock a zero-dues shop from the UI. Add a 'Show all shops' toggle.

issues: During the ~2.3s re-price, the amount, balance and CTA briefly show the new % of the OLD grand total (e.g. 70% of the discounted total) with no loading cue on the ladder itself. Consider a spinner or dimmed state on pay-now-amount.
The 100% note says 'recalculate to see your new total', but the page now re-prices automatically, so the wording is stale.

action_items: HIGH: build cart_signature from the full priced payload (items + include_shipping + delivery_pincode + voucher_code + credit_note_code + redeem_rewards_inr; also provider and channel), or store the priced grand_total and re-price before reusing
HIGH: give the B2BOrderSummary text an explicit dark colour (the item name, line total, subtotal and GST are invisible under html.dark)
Clear awaitingIntent on payPercent, voucher or credit-note change, or disable the CTA while awaiting
Admin b2b-payments h1: change text-white to text-slate-800 dark:text-white (subtitle too)
Admin UI: expose include_all=true ('Show all shops') so a zero-dues shop can be locked
Make review_proof atomic (find_one_and_update on status=pending); add stale 'confirming' recovery; avoid setting confirm_failed when the error is 'already being confirmed'
critical_code_review_comments: b2b_checkout_intent.create_intent: dedupe key too narrow (see HIGH issue). It also returns the stored intent without re-checking the current price.

b2b_checkout_intent.confirm_intent: the atomic claim is correct and was verified under 4-way concurrency. find_one_and_update has no projection, so the claimed doc carries _id; it is not returned to the client, so this is harmless.
b2b_payment_gate.review_proof: non-atomic status transition, so a double-credit is possible.
app/retailer/b2b/page.js is 1022 lines and should be split (the ladder/prepay logic could become a hook).

Mobile pad.tsx correctly opens res.payment_url with WebBrowser and links payment-details. login.tsx builds /retailer/register?gstin= without encodeURIComponent, which is fine for the alphanumeric GSTIN.

success_rate.backend: 100% of the requested fix verifications (28/28 tests); 1 new HIGH bug found (intent dedupe key)
success_rate.frontend: ~85%: all 6 requested FE fixes behave, apart from the stale awaiting label; 2 contrast issues (summary text, admin light-mode title)

Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8001 pytest tests/test_b2b_prepayment_gate.py tests/test_b2b_prepay_fixes_iter128.py. Use regal-rose-b2b for mobile too (bold-bakhoor is out of stock). _dedupe_probe.py reproduces the shipping dedupe bug.
rca of the issue: Dedupe bug: create_intent computes cart_signature from order_data.items only, while order_engine.calculate prices with include_shipping/pincode/voucher/credit_note/rewards, so carts that price differently collide. Invisible summary text: B2BOrderSummary spans rely on the inherited colour, and the retailer layout puts html.dark on the page (body colour rgb(250,250,250)) while the card is bg-white. Stale awaiting label: setAwaitingIntent(null) is only called in handleQuantityChange.
